races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: There's a feeling the 3-y-os may come to the fore in this competitive opener. SOVEREIGN VIEW was tackling 1¼m for the first time when successful at Sandown in August and is narrowly preferred to Stoneacre Donny . Low-mileage pair Light of Paris and Black Chiffon are other 3-y-os with something to recommend them. Rajapour and Per Contra may prove best of the older brigade. SOVEREIGN VIEW STONEACRE DONNY LIGHT OF PARIS (GER)

races.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MOBILIZING is a €450,000 purchase and half-sister to useful 2-y-o 5f/6f winners, so is fancied to make a winning debut if the market speaks in her favour. Stablemate Capricious Star showed promise when third at Redcar 21 days ago and is the type to improve so could be the selection's biggest danger, while Lizzie Bennet could do better if she learns to settle. MOBILIZING (IRE) CAPRICIOUS STAR (IRE) LIZZIE BENNET

races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: MARIANNE MOZART is putting it all together now, having shown improved form in a first-time hood before building on that promise to get off the mark at Kempton 9 days ago. She runs off an unchanged mark and can follow up. Lord Abama is only 2 lb higher than for a recent course success and that leaves him still very well treated on old form so he's respected and Pit Boss is capable if getting some luck and the race is run to suit his hold-up style. MARIANNE MOZART (IRE) LORD ABAMA (IRE) PIT BOSS
